_meta: 이집트 아랍어(카이로) 회화 음성 — 목소리·감정·자리 채움. 포르투갈어앱 data/tts/voices.json 과 같은 짜임. 참고 음성은 VoxCPM2(설명은 영어), 문장은 MOSS-TTS(language Arabic). 배역은 make_plan.py 가 화자 이름·성별로 자동 배정(cast_rules). say = 소리 낼 때만 바꿔 읽는 글(숫자 등).
base_text: النهارده بعد الضهر عندي اجتماع، عشان كده عايز أجهز كل حاجة قبلها. وبعدين نتعشى سوا؟

am.desc: An Egyptian man from Cairo in his twenties, clear and gentle voice, Egyptian Arabic accent

af.desc: An Egyptian woman from Cairo in her twenties, clear and soft voice, Egyptian Arabic accent

karim.desc: An Egyptian man in his mid twenties, direct, friendly and slightly deep voice, Cairene Egyptian Arabic accent

youssef.desc: An Egyptian man in his early twenties, fast, bright and energetic voice, Cairene Egyptian Arabic accent

nour.desc: An Egyptian woman in her early twenties, bright, lively and playful voice, Cairene Egyptian Arabic accent

mariam.desc: An Egyptian woman in her mid twenties, calm, dry and witty voice, Cairene Egyptian Arabic accent

man.desc: An Egyptian man in his forties, composed and professional voice, Cairene Egyptian Arabic accent

man2.desc: An Egyptian man in his thirties, relaxed and warm voice, Cairene Egyptian Arabic accent

woman.desc: An Egyptian woman in her forties, confident, calm and professional voice, Cairene Egyptian Arabic accent

woman2.desc: An Egyptian woman in her thirties, warm and kind voice, Cairene Egyptian Arabic accent

uncle.desc: An elderly Egyptian man in his sixties, slow, warm and slightly husky voice, Cairene Egyptian Arabic accent

auntie.desc: An elderly Egyptian woman in her sixties, warm, motherly and expressive voice, Cairene Egyptian Arabic accent

neutral.ref: النهارده عندي اجتماع بعد الضهر، عشان كده هجهز كل حاجة بالراحة.

polite.instruct: polite and professional, like a clerk or station staff
polite.ref: صباح الخير، اتفضل. أقدر أساعد حضرتك في إيه؟ شكرا على زيارتك.

stiff.instruct: very nervous and stiff, formal and overly polite
stiff.ref: متشكر جدا إنك قابلتني. هعمل كل اللي أقدر عليه. ده شرف ليا.

cheerful.ref: أهلا! مبسوط إني شفتك! الجو حلو النهارده ومزاجي عالي.

amused.ref: ههه، ده ظريف أوي! خلاص، عجبني، كمل كده.

teasing.ref: إيه الوش ده؟ يلا احكيلي كل حاجة. مش هقول لحد.

excited.instruct: excited, bursting with energy, bright and loud
excited.ref: عملتها! مش مصدق! ده تحفة بجد، متشكر أوي!

surprised.instruct: surprised, caught off guard, voice jumps
surprised.ref: إيه؟ بجد؟ استنى، انت بتقول إيه؟

shout.instruct: surprised and loud, an exaggerated comic retort
shout.ref: إيه؟ دلوقتي؟ كده فجأة؟ طب أعمل إيه أنا؟

tsukkomi.instruct: a quick sharp comic retort, exasperated but fond
tsukkomi.ref: لأ لأ، مش كده خالص! ليه عملت كده يا عم؟

annoyed.ref: يوه، تاني؟ كفاية بقى الكلام ده، لو سمحت.

sad.ref: كان بس... يوم صعب. سيبك. ما تقلقش عليا.

worried.ref: انت كويس؟ في حاجة بتوجعك؟ مش أحسن نروح للدكتور؟

flustered.ref: آه، ده... قصدي... مش ده اللي كنت عايز أقوله...

shy.ref: بصراحة... أنا كمان بحب أقعد معاك. ما تقولش لحد.

gentle.ref: كله تمام. أنا هنا جنبك. ارتاح شوية.
